name: REDtone Digital Berhad
overview: 2026年，REDtone Digital Berhad 的公告主要涉及股东授权更新、股息派发及一项关联方中期票据认购，未披露各业务板块的扩张、缩减或新合约信息。公司营收同比下降，但公告中未说明具体业务变化。
overview_en: In 2026, REDtone Digital Berhad's announcements mainly covered renewal of shareholder mandates, dividend payment, and a related party subscription of medium term notes, with no disclosure of expansion, reduction, or new contracts for any business segment. Revenue declined year-on-year, but no specific business changes were explained in the announcements.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年公告主要涉及股东授权更新、股息派发及一项关联方中期票据认购，未提及具体业务板块动态。
segments.note_en: This year's announcements mainly involved renewal of shareholder mandates, dividend payment, and a related party subscription of medium term notes, with no specific segment updates.

actions.title: REDtone Digital Berhad - Circular/Statement to Shareholders in relation to the Proposed Renewal of and New Shareholders' Mandates for Recurr
actions.text: 以进行收入或交易性质的经常性关联交易。
actions.text_en: Proposed renewal of and new shareholders' mandates for recurrent related party transactions of a revenue or trading nature, and proposed renewal of authority for the company to purchase its own shares.

actions.title: REDTONE - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 宣布每股2.0仙的中期股息，除权日为2026年9月24日，派发日为2026年10月16日。
actions.text_en: Declared an interim dividend of 2.0 sen per share, with ex-date 24 September 2026 and payment date 16 October 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 认购Berjaya IPS Equity Sdn. Bhd.发行的中期票据。
actions.text_en: Subscription of Medium Term Notes issued by Berjaya IPS Equity Sdn. Bhd.
